This individual was an '''[[Imperial Guard]] Master''' who served [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was one of dozens of Guardsmen that accompanied their Emperor to the [[Dark Temple]] on the outskirts of [[Kaas City]]. When the [[Hero of Tython]] embarked on a mission to confront the Emperor and prevent him from consuming life, he was slain by the Jedi.
